breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'the free end is unconstrained (rotation not forced to zero)' and correctly uses θ(L) = PL²/(2EI), treating the free end as free to rotate under the applied load.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the correct cantilever formulas θ(L) = PL²/(2EI) and δ(L) = PL³/(3EI), which properly account for the linearly varying bending moment along the span, rather than treating it as constant and equal to PL.
